question: Protection of life and liberty is included under which Article of the Constitution of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 21**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Article 21: Protection of Life and Personal Liberty
 
• This article declares that no person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to the procedure established by law.
 
• This right is available to both citizens and non-citizens
